HazardProvider.description: A public web service of hazard values by coordinates.

service.description: The service's name, as the consent shows.
service.title: Service

reference.description: The code edition the values are for (ASCE 7-22, ...).
reference.title: Reference

endpoint.description: The https URL the query is sent to.
endpoint.title: Endpoint

query.description: Query parameter -> its value, a template of PLACEHOLDERS ({latitude}, {longitude}, {riskCategory}, {siteClass}) and fixed text.
query.title: Query

status.description: Dotted path -> the value an answer with values has there (else refused).
status.title: Status

message.description: Dotted paths of the service's error message.
message.title: Message

riskCategories.description: The project's occupancy (risk) category -> the service's value.
riskCategories.title: Riskcategories

siteClasses.description: The pack's site class id -> the service's value; a class not listed is not looked up (it needs a site-specific study, say).
siteClasses.title: Siteclasses

regions.description: Where the service gives values; empty: anywhere.
regions.title: Regions

decimals.description: Decimals of the coordinates sent (4: about 10 m).
decimals.title: Decimals

terms.description: The service's terms of use (a URL or note).
terms.title: Terms

inheritable.description: False: only the pack whose own data file names the provider uses it (a pack that extends it, for another country, does not send its sites there).
inheritable.title: Inheritable

HazardProvider.title: HazardProvider

HazardRegion.description:
A latitude/longitude box the service gives values for (a site outside every box of a
provider that has boxes is not sent).

east.description: East edge; below west: the box crosses 180°.
east.title: East

HazardRegion.title: HazardRegion

HazardValue.description:
One value of the answer: where it is (dotted paths into the JSON answer, the first one
found is taken) and the factor to the unit of its settings field (:data:`TARGETS`). A
spectrum (designSpectrum, mcerSpectrum) is two arrays: ``periods`` [s] and ``ordinates``.

target.description: The settings field it fills (one of TARGETS).
target.title: Target

label.description: How the results name it (SDS, SD1, ...).
label.title: Label

path.description: Dotted paths of a single value; the first found.
path.title: Path

unit.description: The service's unit of the value, as its documentation says.
unit.title: Unit

scale.description: Factor from the service's unit to the settings field's.
scale.title: Scale

HazardValue.title: HazardValue

description: The pack's hazard services by site coordinates (see the module notes).

source.description: Clause (and page) the table comes from.
source.title: Source

sources.description: Clause references of single entries: {key: clause}.
sources.title: Sources

clauses.description: Short clause references the results cite, by key, without the code's name (e.g. 'Part 6 Sec 2.5.7.3'); read by saengine.codes.context.cite. A key the pack does not give is not cited.
clauses.title: Clauses

manualNote.description: What the engineer does where no provider covers the site (the code's maps or tool by hand).
manualNote.title: Manualnote

title: HazardLookupTable
